timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1500–1510 KRW/USD (prospective); current level appears higher before decline

WHY: The news indicates the won is currently weak (high KRW/USD), meaning dollars are expensive right now. While one article suggests the rate *could* fall to 1500–1510 next week due to Middle East tension easing, the second article emphasizes the rate has recently hit a 17-year high and only stabilized after central bank intervention—implying you are buying dollars at elevated prices today.

TIP: Given your fixed $2,000 monthly obligation, consider setting a limit order to convert at 1500 KRW/USD or below, or dollar-cost average small amounts weekly to reduce timing risk rather than converting the full amount now.

articles.title: 고삐 풀린 환율 17년래 최고…실물경제 ‘휘청’
articles.summary: 원·달러 환율이 금융위기 수준까지 치솟으며 실물경제에 부담을 줄 수 있다는 우려가 커지고 있다. 금융당국의 구두 개입에 상승세는 일단 진정됐지.
